allowed_behavior_design.correction_boundary: tentative or invalidated Claims may not masquerade as verified inputs
allowed_behavior_design.decision_basis: different valid typed evidential basis for the same required obligation
allowed_behavior_design.derivation_dependencies: different grounded typed route discharging all unchanged required obligations
allowed_behavior_design.evidence_support: different sufficient support within unchanged visible universe and role/citation constraints
allowed_behavior_design.observation_update: observation-grounded rejection or revision with correct State and dependency propagation

equivalence_design.alpha_renaming: runtime IDs map bijectively to actual producers and all their references
equivalence_design.canonicalization_requirement: deterministic identity up to semantic-label-preserving graph isomorphism
equivalence_design.decimal_surface: finite exact Decimal equality, no rounding or approximate tolerance relation
equivalence_design.distinctness: same fixed scope, two own-qualified executions, and a replay-supported retained-field difference
equivalence_design.domain: future independently Qualified own-execution trajectories for one fixed Task and contract
equivalence_design.failed_or_unreplayed_candidate: outside quotient domain, never a new class
equivalence_design.graph_or_program_hash_difference_alone: not sufficient to establish a semantic difference
equivalence_design.ordered_operands: preserve roles; sort only explicitly registered unordered/commutative domains
equivalence_design.relation: equality of a future canonical typed public causal behavior representation
equivalence_design.schedule_swap: only independent commuting actions with no conflicting Claim or State effects
equivalence_design.source_alias_rule: only preregistered source-content, locator, role and authority preserving mappings; equal numeric values alone cannot merge distinct evidential grounds
equivalence_design.synthetic_padding_or_method_labels: not sufficient to establish a semantic difference
equivalence_design.transitivity: exact canonical equality required; pairwise numeric closeness is prohibited
equivalence_design.unregistered_algebraic_rewrite: outside this design domain until a rule is preregistered
equivalence_design.updates: retain meaningful revisions and rejection causality; timestamps and callback order alone vanish
equivalence_design.wording: only nonauthoritative surface text; changing a typed proposition or basis is retained

historical_control.accepted_result: one quotient class per Task in that frozen candidate family
historical_control.scope: two historical Tasks, two legal schedules per Task

oracle_and_obligation_boundary.alternative_derivation: requires its own typed execution and evidence-to-obligation discharge mapping
oracle_and_obligation_boundary.historical_five_step_execute_only_graph: verified local candidate subdomain, not universal route grammar
oracle_and_obligation_boundary.missing_alternative_validator: candidate family remains unimplemented; never waive validation
oracle_and_obligation_boundary.oracle_program_node_identity: source lineage, not mandatory candidate decision identity
oracle_and_obligation_boundary.required_obligations: must still be discharged under unchanged validation semantics

decision_basis: typed supports, requires, rules_out or insufficient relation
actual source Evidence or verified Claim and the supported proposition
derivation_dependencies: registered operation semantics and typed ordered operand roles
actual producer-to-consumer Claim dependency edges and obligation discharge
semantic Claim payload with exact values, units and grounding
evidence_support: source content binding, locator, role, period, definition, unit and authority
actually selected visible support subset and its decision-use edges
observation_update: actual supporting Observation and accept, reject or revise disposition
old and replacement Claim semantics, revision dependency and uncertainty change
invalidation of affected downstream Claims and actual enabled actions
public_behavior_fields.termination: public terminal disposition and final answer/citation semantics
public_behavior_fields.termination_change_request_boundary: retained in any future projection; changing terminal policy is outside the current change-request domain and cannot waive the frozen answer contract

required_future_validations: bind identical Task and frozen evidence, Oracle, answer, citation, and validity scope
bind the behavior contract before candidate execution and outcome inspection
reconstruct each candidate from its own actual State, Envelope, execution, Observation, Update
check visible evidence and verified-Claim access at every actual pre-action boundary
recompute QA validity and all required public decision obligations without a reference-route oracle
establish actual action and update semantics, including meaningful causal dependencies
qualify each actual trajectory independently before any future quotient projection

host: derive legal candidates from frozen public rules and current State without answer-directed route filtering
resolve source references and execute exactly the chosen registered tool/arithmetic action
persist commitments and receipts, fsync artifacts and preserve actual callback ordering
validate proposed updates, apply exact State changes and independently recompute the Oracle
reject malformed or unsupported choices instead of silently substituting a successful route
model_if_later_authorized: choose visible supporting evidence, typed basis, strategy, operands and next action before execution
propose an observation-grounded Claim update and uncertainty/subgoal change
own only semantic fields supplied by its corresponding phase-correct proposal
action choices precede execution; Update proposals follow Observation and precede the next State commit
required_future_provenance: field_origin: frozen_contract, host_derived, model_proposed, or deterministic_fixture
bind raw proposal, admitted action, host transformation and actual execution without imputed ownership

same_task_scope.answer_contract: fixed answer schema, units, numeric tolerance and rounding
same_task_scope.evidence_universe: exact authorized source universe and fixed role, visibility and authority constraints
same_task_scope.oracle_program: exact answer-correctness Oracle Program and its binding
same_task_scope.task_definition: exact Task, question, entity, periods, metric definitions and objective
same_task_scope.validity_obligations: fixed QA and trajectory validation semantics and required public obligations

scientific_object: public evidence-grounded decisions and their causal updates
